sources.title: Standard Geographical Classification (SGC) 2021 - Classification structure
sources.refreshPolicy: new SGC release plus official interim municipal changes
sources.notes: Provides the national geography spine. It does not by itself prove that every CSD has a governing body.

plannedSources.title: Census Subdivision Boundary File, 2025
plannedSources.transport: GPKG, SHP, GML, GDB, Esri REST, or WMS
plannedSources.notes: Current intercensal CSD layer. It must be added before current legal-geography coverage can be complete.

plannedSources.title: First Nations Location
plannedSources.transport: CSV, GPKG, SHP, FGDB, WFS, WMS, or Esri REST
plannedSources.notes: National First Nations anchor. Reserve geography and First Nation government identity must remain separate.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Directory
plannedSources.transport: HTML, dated PDF rosters, and ArcGIS boundary service
plannedSources.notes: Reconcile towns, cities, Inuit Community Governments, local service districts, and regional service boards as distinct body types.

plannedSources.title: PEI Municipalities and Municipal Directory
plannedSources.notes: Confirm whether the PEI Open Government Licence covers each selected service before redistribution.

plannedSources.title: Municipality Boundaries and Village Boundaries
plannedSources.transport: Socrata CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, OData, SHP, or GDB
plannedSources.notes: Incorporated villages require the separate official village-boundaries dataset and a distinct body type.

plannedSources.title: GeoNB Local Governance
plannedSources.transport: ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, PBF, FGDB, KML, or SHP
plannedSources.notes: Local governments, rural districts, and regional service commissions are separate entity classes.

plannedSources.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
plannedSources.title: Répertoire des municipalités du Québec
plannedSources.notes: Preserve provincial geographic codes, MRCs, boroughs, metropolitan bodies, history, and relationships.

plannedSources.title: Ontario Municipalities
plannedSources.transport: CKAN CSV/API plus LIO ArcGIS municipal boundary layers
plannedSources.notes: Combine the official roster with LIO identifiers; northern districts are geography, not municipal governments.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Officials Directory
plannedSources.notes: Exclude personal official contact details; separately model planning, watershed, assessment, and northern bodies.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Directory
plannedSources.notes: Use Statistics Canada for the redistributable core until bulk-directory reuse permission is confirmed.

plannedSources.title: Municipal Locations and Codes
plannedSources.transport: Municipal code/history files and profile downloads
plannedSources.notes: Preserve hamlets, special areas, improvement districts, Métis Settlements, and regional service commissions as distinct classes.

plannedSources.title: Municipalities - Legally Defined Administrative Areas
plannedSources.transport: ArcGIS REST JSON, GeoJSON, or PBF
plannedSources.notes: Regional districts use a separate official layer and must be represented as upper-tier/shared-service bodies.

plannedSources.title: Local Government Directory
plannedSources.transport: Dated PDF plus CKAN/Esri municipal-boundary dataset
plannedSources.notes: Municipalities, local advisory councils, and Indigenous governments remain separate entity types.

plannedSources.title: MACA Communities
plannedSources.notes: Preserve the distinction between municipalities and designated authorities; omit personal contact fields.

plannedSources.title: Current Hamlets Act and continuation orders
plannedSources.notes: Use Statistics Canada as the machine-readable base and obtain reuse approval before redistributing a bulk legal roster.
